title: The sandbox dispatch door carries the worker's harness and prompt, and the worker's logs stream
description: Absorbed from yoh findings fe91398b (xev), d09ef48c (a08) and 8a263ee1 (l6t), 2026-09-24. After l6t the only cloud worker path is ticfac's cloudflare-sandbox executor through the Worker's dispatch door. The door carries the model (a08) but not the harness and not the prompt: the harness rests on RUN_WORKER_HARNESS agreeing with the cloud profile, the role prompt never reaches the container, and workers boot with no harness bound and no streamed logs (the wave path set both). A cloud epic run cannot do real work through that door, so this gates yoh's definition of done and u9h. Make the dispatch request carry harness and prompt (or a reference the container can fetch), boot the worker with them, stream its log the way the wave path did, and record both in the attempt record.
acceptance_criteria: A dispatch through the door carries the resolved harness and the rendered prompt; the worker boots with exactly those (a test proves both reach the container's environment/files); the worker's output streams to the run's logs; the attempt record names the harness; the door contract (sandbox-dispatch.ts) documents the fields; go and ts gates pass
